variables.name: Primary/primary
variables.description: The action color: primary buttons, links, selection and focus of fields.

variables.name: Primary/primaryDeep
variables.description: Pressed fill of primary contained buttons.

variables.name: Primary/primaryStrong
variables.description: Hover fill of primary contained buttons; emphasized primary text.

variables.name: Primary/primarySubtle
variables.description: Pressed fill of ghost and subtle buttons; primary hover outline.

variables.name: Primary/primaryDimmed
variables.description: Soft primary fill: ghost-button hover, selected subtle buttons, primary badges and avatars.

variables.name: Positive/positive
variables.description: Success state. Passed, completed or healthy.

variables.name: Positive/positiveDeep
variables.description: Positive banner and snackbar titles; hover fill of positive contained buttons.

variables.name: Positive/positiveStrong
variables.description: Positive tag text; pressed fill of positive contained buttons.

variables.name: Positive/positiveDimmed
variables.description: Soft positive fill behind positive text: tags, badges, status icons, subtle buttons.

variables.name: Positive/positiveSubtle
variables.description: Hover fill of clickable positive tags and positive subtle buttons; pressed fill of positive ghost buttons.

variables.name: Positive/positiveBorder
variables.description: Outline of positive tags, status icons and subtle buttons.

variables.name: Warning/warning
variables.description: Warning state. Needs attention, nothing has failed yet.

variables.name: Warning/warningDeep
variables.description: Warning banner and snackbar titles; hover fill of warning contained buttons.

variables.name: Warning/warningStrong
variables.description: Warning tag text; pressed fill of warning contained buttons.

variables.name: Warning/warningDimmed
variables.description: Soft warning fill behind warning text: tags, badges, status icons, subtle buttons.

variables.name: Warning/warningSubtle
variables.description: Hover fill of clickable warning tags and warning subtle buttons; pressed fill of warning ghost buttons.

variables.name: Warning/warningBorder
variables.description: Outline of warning tags, status icons and subtle buttons.

variables.name: Negative/negative
variables.description: Error state. Failed, invalid or destructive.

variables.name: Negative/negativeDeep
variables.description: Negative banner and snackbar titles; hover fill of negative contained buttons.

variables.name: Negative/negativeStrong
variables.description: Negative tag text; pressed fill of negative contained buttons.

variables.name: Negative/negativeDimmed
variables.description: Soft negative fill behind negative text: tags, badges, status icons, subtle buttons.

variables.name: Negative/negativeSubtle
variables.description: Hover fill of clickable negative tags and negative subtle buttons; pressed fill of negative ghost buttons.

variables.name: Negative/negativeBorder
variables.description: Outline of negative tags, status icons and subtle buttons.

variables.name: Info/info
variables.description: Informational state. Neutral news, no action needed.

variables.name: Info/infoDeep
variables.description: Info banner and snackbar titles.

variables.name: Info/infoStrong
variables.description: Info tag text.

variables.name: Info/infoDimmed
variables.description: Soft info fill behind info text: tags, badges, status icons, subtle buttons.

variables.name: Info/infoSubtle
variables.description: Hover fill of clickable info tags.

variables.name: Info/infoBorder
variables.description: Outline of info tags, status icons and subtle buttons.

variables.name: Accent/accent
variables.description: Accent for highlights that are neither action nor status.

variables.name: Accent/accentDeep
variables.description: Accent banner and snackbar titles.

variables.name: Accent/accentStrong
variables.description: Stronger accent for hover and emphasized accent text; no Pentaho UI Kit component uses it yet.

variables.name: Accent/accentSubtle
variables.description: Soft accent fill one step above accentDimmed; no Pentaho UI Kit component uses it yet.

variables.name: Accent/accentDimmed
variables.description: Softest accent fill: accent banners (mixed half with dimmer) and accent status icons.

variables.name: Accent/accentBorder
variables.description: Outline of accent status icons and accent-tinted surfaces.

variables.name: Text/text
variables.description: Primary text: body copy, titles and values.

variables.name: Text/textSubtle
variables.description: Secondary text: help text, placeholders, metadata and subheaders.

variables.name: Text/textDisabled
variables.description: Disabled text, icons and control outlines; intentionally low contrast.

variables.name: Text/textDimmed
variables.description: A muted gray for control outlines rather than reading text.

variables.name: Text/textLight
variables.description: Light text in both modes, for saturated or dark fills.

variables.name: Text/textDark
variables.description: Dark text in both modes: on warning fills, and in light mode on the soft …Dimmed fills and the lighter categorical colors.

variables.name: Borders/border
variables.description: Default border for outlined controls and containers.

variables.name: Borders/borderSubtle
variables.description: Hairline dividers between surfaces and rows.

variables.name: Borders/borderStrong
variables.description: Emphasized outline of small selection controls.

variables.name: Borders/borderDisabled
variables.description: Outline of disabled checkboxes and radios.

variables.name: Surfaces/bgPage
variables.description: The page background, behind containers.

variables.name: Surfaces/bgContainer
variables.description: Surface for containers: cards, panels, dialogs, drawers, tooltips and table rows.

variables.name: Surfaces/bgPageSecondary
variables.description: A step darker than the page: selected and focused list items, tracks and placeholders.

variables.name: Surfaces/bgContainerSecondary
variables.description: A secondary surface inside containers: nested regions and avatar fills.

variables.name: Surfaces/bgHover
variables.description: Translucent primary tint for hover on rows, list items, tabs and ghost controls.

variables.name: Surfaces/bgDisabled
variables.description: Fill of disabled controls and disabled contained buttons.

variables.name: Surfaces/bgOverlay
variables.description: Translucent backdrop behind dialogs and drawers.

variables.name: Surfaces/dimmer
variables.description: Mix target that softens colors (light in light mode, dark in dark mode).

variables.name: Other/shad1
variables.description: The translucent shadow color the elevation is built from; no component uses it directly.
